newsitem.title: USA: Abiomed recalls cardiac sytsem products.
newsitem.headline: Abiomed recalls cardiac sytsem products.

text.p: Abiomed Inc said on Wednesday that it has voluntarily recalled its BVS-5000 cardiac support system belonging to production lots where components have exhibited irregularities.
Abiomed said that due to the timing of this action, it is unlikely that the company will be able to ship all BVS customer orders in this current fiscal quarter.
The company said that if it needs to replace and/or repair all product in the affected lots, it estimates that the total direct cost would not exceed $200,000.
According to Abiomed, no patients have been affected.

The company said it has taken steps to help fill emergency orders from customers and is increasing manufacturing capacity to produce sufficient quantities of the BVS product prior to the end of its March 31 fiscal year.
